meta.description: AMONEDACION ARGENTINA - NFT digital collection of Argentine coins
meta.keywords: NFT, Argentine coins, numismatics, digital collection, blockchain

inicio.p-1: AMONEDACION ARGENTINA is the first digital project that merges traditional numismatics with blockchain technology, creating a unique collection of historical Argentine coins tokenized as NFTs. Its goal is to preserve and disseminate Argentina's cultural and monetary heritage in an innovative, accessible, and secure format.
inicio.p-2: Each NFT represents a genuine Argentine coin, documented with detailed characteristics such as face value, year, mint, composition, weight, and rarity, forming a digital catalog that allows these pieces to be collected, studied, and valued in a transparent and decentralized manner.
inicio.p-3: The project is aimed at collectors, researchers, and enthusiasts of numismatics and emerging technologies, offering a bridge between monetary history and the digital future. Through its platform and official channels, it promotes transparency, education, and community, inviting everyone to be part of this cultural revolution.
inicio.p-4: As a complement, the catalog "La Moneda Argentina y sus Defectos Recurrentes" is available, documenting the real-world physical coins that form the basis and context for the NFTs, strengthening the connection between the tangible and the digital.
inicio.moneda-p-1: A coin is a metallic piece minted by an issuing authority—usually a State—that holds legal value and is used as a medium of exchange, a measure of value, and a store of wealth.
inicio.moneda-p-2: Throughout history, coins have not only served to facilitate transactions but have also reflected the political, economic, cultural, and artistic aspects of a nation.
inicio.numismatica-p-1: Numismatics is the study and collection of coins, banknotes, and medals. Beyond their monetary value, each piece serves as a historical, artistic, and cultural testimony of a specific time and society.
inicio.numismatica-p-2: At AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, numismatics merges with emerging technologies to preserve and share Argentina's monetary heritage in an innovative, secure, and globally accessible format.
inicio.nft-p-1: NFT stands for "Non-Fungible Token". It's a special type of unique digital asset that represents ownership or authenticity of a digital item, such as art, music, collectibles, and more, recorded on a blockchain.
inicio.coleccion-nft-p-1: An NFT collection is a structured set of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) that share a common theme. In the case of AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, the collection functions as a digital catalog of Argentine coins, where each NFT represents a specific physical coin, documented and classified.
inicio.blockchain-p-1: A blockchain is a decentralized and distributed database that records transactions in a secure, transparent, and immutable way. Each block in the chain contains a set of data and is linked to the previous block through a cryptographic code, forming a continuous and verifiable sequence.
inicio.blockchain-p-2: Thanks to its structure, a blockchain does not rely on a central authority and is resistant to tampering. This technology is the foundation of cryptocurrencies and NFTs, as it enables the certification of authenticity and ownership of digital assets without the need for intermediaries.
inicio.blockchain-p-3: In AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, the NFT coins are registered on the Ethereum blockchain, one of the most widely used and secure networks in the world. This ensures that each digital piece is unique, traceable, and permanent, preserving the value and history of Argentine coins in the digital realm.
inicio.ethereum-p-1: Ethereum is an open-source blockchain platform that enables the creation and execution of smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps). It was created in 2015 by Vitalik Buterin and has since become one of the leading technologies for developing digital assets, including cryptocurrencies and NFTs.
inicio.ethereum-p-2: Unlike Bitcoin, which primarily focuses on being a digital currency, Ethereum offers an infrastructure that facilitates the programming of automatic and transparent agreements without intermediaries. Its native cryptocurrency is Ether (ETH), which is used to pay for transactions and services within the network.
inicio.ethereum-p-3: In AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, Ethereum is the blockchain that ensures the security, authenticity, and permanence of each NFT coin within the collection.
inicio.transaccion-titulo: What is a Transaction on Ethereum?
inicio.transaccion-p-1: A transaction on Ethereum is an action recorded on the blockchain that can include transfers of Ether (ETH), execution of smart contracts, or interaction with decentralized applications (dApps). Each transaction must be validated by the network to ensure its authenticity and prevent fraud or double spending.
inicio.transaccion-p-2: Transactions require the payment of a fee called “gas,” which compensates validators for the computational work necessary to process them. Gas is measured in units, and its price varies according to network demand.
inicio.transaccion-p-3: In AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, transactions ensure that the buying, selling, or transferring of NFT coins is secure, transparent, and permanently recorded on the Ethereum blockchain.
inicio.gas-p-1: Gas fees are charges paid to perform transactions or execute operations on the Ethereum blockchain. These fees compensate validators for the computational resources required to process and verify each action on the network.
inicio.gas-p-2: Gas is measured in units, and its cost varies depending on the network demand at any given time. The user initiating the transaction can choose how much gas to pay, which affects how quickly their transaction is processed.
inicio.gas-p-3: In AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, gas fees are necessary to buy, sell, or transfer NFT coins, ensuring that these actions are secure and reliably recorded on the blockchain.
inicio.tokenizacion-p-1: Tokenization is the process of converting a physical or digital asset into a token on a blockchain. This token acts as a verifiable and unique representation of the original item within digital environments.
inicio.tokenizacion-p-2: At AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, real physical coins are tokenized as NFTs, allowing them to be collected, displayed, and traded securely and in a decentralized way, while maintaining a direct link to the tangible object.
inicio.moneda-nft-p-1: A tokenized NFT coin is a digital representation recorded on a blockchain that reflects a real physical coin. Through a Non-Fungible Token (NFT), its authenticity, traceability, and permanence in the digital environment are guaranteed.
inicio.moneda-nft-p-2: In the case of AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, each NFT is linked to a specific coin documented in the catalog "La Moneda Argentina y sus Defectos Recurrentes", which has multiple but limited digital copies available depending on its rarity level. This allows several collectors to own examples of the same type, without losing the connection to the original physical item.
inicio.moneda-nft-p-3: This system merges the historical value of physical coins with the benefits of the digital world, enabling them to be collected, displayed, and traded in a secure and decentralized way.
inicio.rareza-p-1: Each NFT coin in the collection is classified according to its rarity, reflecting its availability and relative value within the set. These rarity grades are directly related to the number of physical specimens documented in the coin catalog La Moneda Argentina y sus Defectos Recurrentes ("The Argentine Coin and its Recurring Defects"), thus bridging traditional and digital collecting.
inicio.rareza-p-2: In numismatics, rarity indicates the difficulty of obtaining a piece, beyond its price, date, or condition. This classification also applies in the digital realm: greater rarity means lower availability of NFTs and generally a higher challenge to acquire them.

inicio.wallet-p-1: A wallet is a digital application or device that allows users to store, send, and receive digital assets such as cryptocurrencies and NFTs. It operates using cryptographic keys: a public key (similar to an address) that can be shared to receive assets, and a private key that must be kept secure, as it grants access to manage those assets.
inicio.wallet-p-2: In the context of AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, the wallet is essential for users to acquire, hold, and transfer their NFT coins securely and in a decentralized way. Wallets can be mobile, desktop, web-based, or hardware devices. Some of the most popular ones include MetaMask, Trust Wallet, and Ledger.
inicio.metamask-p-1: MetaMask is a digital wallet that allows you to interact with the Ethereum blockchain directly from a web browser or mobile device. It works as an extension in browsers like Chrome, Firefox, or Brave, and is also available as an app for iOS and Android.
inicio.metamask-p-2: With MetaMask, users can manage cryptocurrencies like ETH, view and manage their NFTs, and securely connect to decentralized websites (dApps) such as OpenSea.
inicio.metamask-p-3: To use AMONEDACION ARGENTINA and purchase digital coins from the collection, you need to have a MetaMask account, hold an Ethereum (ETH) balance, and connect your wallet to the corresponding NFT marketplace.
inicio.mercado-nft-titulo: What is an NFT Marketplace (like OpenSea)?
inicio.mercado-nft-p-1: An NFT marketplace is a platform where you can buy, sell, and trade NFTs using a digital wallet. It allows creators, collectors, and investors to operate with these digital assets.
inicio.mercado-nft-p-2: Popular examples include OpenSea, Rarible, OKX NFT and LooksRare. In AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, you can acquire NFT coins directly through any of these marketplaces.
inicio.exchange-titulo: What is a Crypto Exchange (like Binance)?
inicio.exchange-p-1: A crypto exchange is a digital platform that allows users to buy, sell, trade, or store digital assets such as cryptocurrencies (e.g., Ether or Bitcoin). These platforms enable you to purchase crypto using traditional currencies (like dollars or pesos) or exchange one cryptocurrency for another.
inicio.exchange-p-2: There are different types of exchanges, but the most popular ones -such as Binance, Coinbase, OKX, or Kraken- offer user-friendly interfaces and multiple payment methods to help newcomers enter the crypto world. Once you buy cryptocurrency on an exchange, you can transfer it to your personal wallet (like MetaMask) and use it to purchase NFTs or other digital assets.
inicio.comprar-nft-p-1: To purchase an NFT from the AMONEDACION ARGENTINA collection, follow these steps:
inicio.comprar-nft-li-1: Install a wallet compatible with Ethereum. MetaMask is recommended and is available as a browser extension and mobile app.
inicio.comprar-nft-li-2: Buy Ether (ETH), the cryptocurrency of the Ethereum network, on a trusted exchange and transfer it to your wallet.
inicio.comprar-nft-li-3: Visit the marketplace where the NFTs are listed, such as OpenSea, and connect your wallet.
inicio.comprar-nft-li-4: Browse the collection and select the digital coin you wish to purchase.
inicio.comprar-nft-li-5: Follow the NFT marketplace's instructions to buy the NFT using your wallet.
inicio.comprar-nft-li-6: Confirm the transaction by approving the operation and gas fees in your wallet.
inicio.transferir-ether-titulo: How to Transfer Ether from an Exchange to your Wallet
inicio.transferir-ether-p-1: Once you have purchased Ether (ETH) on an exchange such as Binance, you need to transfer it to your personal wallet in order to use it for buying NFTs or other digital assets.
inicio.transferir-ether-p-2: Steps to transfer ETH to your wallet (e.g., MetaMask):
inicio.transferir-ether-li-1: Open your wallet and copy your public Ethereum address. It is an alphanumeric string that starts with 0x....
inicio.transferir-ether-li-2: Log in to the exchange where you bought the ETH (e.g., Binance).
inicio.transferir-ether-li-4: Select Ethereum (ETH) as the cryptocurrency to withdraw.
inicio.transferir-ether-li-5: Paste your wallet address into the appropriate field.
inicio.transferir-ether-li-6: Enter the amount of ETH you want to transfer.
inicio.transferir-ether-li-7: Make sure to select the Ethereum (ERC-20) network to avoid errors or loss of funds.
inicio.transferir-ether-li-8: Make sure you have enough ETH to cover the price of the NFT you want to buy and the gas fees, which may vary depending on network congestion.
inicio.transferir-ether-li-9: Confirm the transaction and complete any required verification steps from the exchange.
inicio.transferir-ether-p-3: Within a few minutes, your Ether should appear in your wallet and be ready for use on NFT marketplaces like OpenSea.
inicio.album-titulo: What is the NFT Album of AMONEDACION ARGENTINA?
inicio.album-p-1: The NFT Album is a digital tool designed to organize and display your collection of tokenized coins.
inicio.album-li-1: Thematic classifications and rarity grades (R1 to R5).
inicio.album-li-2: Interactive visualization to examine the numismatic details of each piece.
inicio.album-li-3: Direct integration with major NFT marketplaces for easy collection management.
inicio.album-li-4: Verified technical information about each monetary issue.
inicio.album-p-3: This platform combines traditional collecting with blockchain advantages, offering a modern and accessible cataloging experience.

autor.p-1: Federico Aguirre Horn is an engineer, forensic computer expert, and enthusiast of Argentine numismatics, residing in Buenos Aires. For more than thirty years, he has been dedicated to the systematic study of coins issued in Argentina, with special attention to their technical aspects, history, and variants.
autor.p-2: He is the author of the catalog La Moneda Argentina y sus Defectos Recurrentes ("The Argentine Coin and its Recurring Defects"), a numismatic research work he has been developing for over a decade, whose first chapter was published online in 2025. This initial release is dedicated to Argentine legal tender coins, covering their historical context, physical characteristics, and main particularities. The catalog is closely linked to the development of his NFT collection, integrating traditional numismatic knowledge with contemporary technological tools.
autor.p-3: In 2024, Federico created the first NFT of AMONEDACION ARGENTINA, presented as the world’s first catalog of tokenized coins, using the Ethereum network. This pioneering collection aims to digitally preserve numismatic heritage, facilitating access and knowledge through images, technical data, and the historical context of each piece.
autor.p-4: Each NFT has been made from original photographs and classifications performed by the author, who is also responsible for the website development and smart contract implementation. His goal is to bring traditional numismatics closer to the digital world and encourage the exchange of knowledge among collectors, researchers, and enthusiasts worldwide.

catalogo.p-1: La Moneda Argentina y sus Defectos Recurrentes ("The Argentine Coin and its Recurring Defects") is a catalog of physical Argentine coins, authentic and rigorously documented. Each piece is presented with photographs and specific data: face value, year, mint, composition, weight, alignment, edge, rarity, and mintage.
catalogo.p-2: Each entry includes images of the obverse and reverse, clear descriptions, and a direct link to its corresponding NFT in the AMONEDACION ARGENTINA collection, allowing a certified digital representation on the blockchain. This strengthens the connection between the tangible numismatic heritage and its digital representation.
catalogo.p-3: The catalog is free to access and is continuously expanding, aimed at collectors, researchers, and enthusiasts of Argentine monetary history.
catalogo.cap-1-p-1: This chapter is dedicated to coins that were issued as legal tender in the Argentine Republic. These pieces circulated commonly in daily life, many of which may have passed through our own hands.
catalogo.cap-1-p-2: Its study allows a rediscovery of the cultural and documentary value of common coins within the framework of the country's monetary history.
catalogo.cap-2-p-1: This chapter will be unlocked when the collection reaches 1,000 unique collectors.
catalogo.cap-2-p-2: This chapter focuses on commemorative coins, specially designed for collectors and investors. These are non-legal tender coins, which can only (or could only) be purchased directly through the Central Bank of the Argentine Republic or other authorized institutions.
catalogo.cap-2-p-3: These coins are characterized by low mintage, special finishes, and high symbolic value.
catalogo.cap-3-p-1: This chapter will be unlocked when the collection reaches 10,000 unique collectors.
catalogo.cap-3-p-2: This chapter documents recurrent defects —errors and unplanned variants— frequently observed in the coins analyzed in the previous chapters.
catalogo.cap-3-p-3: These defects offer technical, historical, and collectible interest, allowing a deeper appreciation of the minting process and its particularities.
